what: Skyworks Solutions makes radio frequency chips: the components that let phones and devices connect to mobile and Wi-Fi networks. Apple has historically been its largest customer by a wide margin.
customers: Smartphone makers, especially Apple, plus automotive, industrial and infrastructure equipment manufacturers.
money: radio frequency front-end modules for smartphones
connectivity chips for automotive, industrial, infrastructure and home devices
moat: Radio frequency design and filter manufacturing that is difficult to replicate, with content designed into phone platforms years in advance.
risks: Extreme customer concentration with Apple, which is bringing more components in-house
Revenue fell about 3% last year and about 6% a year over three years
It suspended its dividend after a merger agreement
opportunities: Broad Markets revenue is less concentrated and growing
Cash of about $2.6 billion roughly matches its debt
Combining with Qorvo would create a much larger radio frequency supplier
watch: Content per phone at its largest customer and Broad Markets growth.
